skill.summary: Generate professional pitch deck outlines using the $1B pitch formula based on startup data and company information.

latestVersion.changelog:
Pitch Deck Outline Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a tool to auto-generate professional pitch deck outlines using the $1B pitch formula.
- Transforms detailed startup and company data into investor-ready, structured slide templates.
- Outlines cover all standard pitch deck sections: problem, solution, market, business model, traction, competition, team, funding ask, and roadmap.
- Provides API endpoints for outline generation, health checks, and service status.
- Includes sample requests/responses and recommendations for deck design and structure.
